name: Belgrade (Serbia)

colors.symbolism: the city walls and the river stripes
the ground and the sky over the rivers

description: A banner of the city arms: on blue, white city walls with an open gate above two white wavy stripes on red (the Sava and Danube), with a Roman trireme.
history: Belgrade is the capital and largest city of Serbia. Its flag and coat of arms reference the medieval and Roman heritage of the city at the confluence of the Sava and Danube.

features.role: banner of the arms of Belgrade
